app.title: KiCad Forge
app.noSymbolsHint: Click Settings in the sidebar to configure your symbol library path, then click Save & Import.
app.importingHint: Importing library. This may take a few minutes the first time.
app.waitHint: You can close this window and continue working.

inspector.lockedHint: Belongs to a locked library: delete, bind and classify are disabled (import sync is not affected)

plugin.pluginHint: Place .kfplug files in the plugins directory

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetDbHint: Deletes all imported metadata. Original .kicad_sym files are NOT touched. Restart the app after reset.
settings.reimportHint: Re-scan configured paths and reimport all symbols/footprints.
settings.compLibHint: A component library bundles symbol, footprint, and 3D model paths together. Add libraries then click Save & Import to scan.
settings.noPaths: No paths configured — click ✎ to edit
settings.officialLocked: Official KiCad library — locked, cannot unlock
settings.writeKfIdHint: Write Kicad_Forge_ID back to .kicad_sym files during import. Disabled by default to protect original files.
settings.standardLibraryGuard: 🔒 Standard KiCad libraries are protected. Do not unlock them. If you need to enable writing Kicad_Forge_ID back to .kicad_sym, be aware this will modify official library files.

rules.title: Classification Rules
rules.editHint: Edit config/classification_rules/*.toml to add custom rules

types.saveHint: Types are saved to config/*_types.json. Changes take effect immediately.

confirm.resetDb:
Reset database? All metadata will be lost.
.kicad_sym files on disk are safe.
Restart the app after.
confirm.deleteCompLibrary: Delete component library "{{name}}"? Only removes config, imported data is kept.
confirm.deleteLibraryHint:
By default this only removes the library from KiCad Forge.
Check the box below to also delete the .kicad_sym file on disk.
confirm.deleteLibraryFileWarning: This will permanently remove the file from disk. This cannot be undone.
